reviews.t: I really wish this had worked for me.
reviews.x: I really wanted to love this deodorant! I had been using the regular Primal Pit Paste, but it unfortunately had been irritating my skin. So I decided to give this "light" one a try. However it did not work well for me. It did not irritate my skin like the other one, however even after applying twice per day (and washing my arm pits before hand), it still did not keep body odor away -- and that was just with regular activity (not working out). I am disappointed as I really really want to

I love this product!!! I have tried tons (probably 10-12) other natural deodorants and this is the only one that works for me.  The regular strength one was too strong for me but the "light" version works great.  Be sure to read on the website about "side effects" because they use baking soda you may have a reaction at first.  That is how I knew the regular strength was too strong.  Check out their other products too ... LOVE THEM!!!

reviews.t: Lavendar scent not strong enough to control odors
reviews.x: First off, I live in the south.....the deep, crazy hot, muggy south. I NEED deoderant down here if I want people to talk to me. I've tried several natural deodorants, plain coconut oil, the clear deoderants that are available at healthfood stores, the crystal.....they just don't hold up down here. Pit paste held up a bit better than the other stuff. I tried the lavendar scent. It's okay....smells kind of like laundry detergent. It does not keep me smelling good for longer than half a day. reviews.t: My favorite natural deodorant on the market
reviews.x: I adore this stuff! It's the best on the market. I went through the baking soda reaction years ago. Most everyone does when making the switch to natural deodorant. I appreciate that PPP puts it on their website and marketing. It helped me realize I wasn't having an allergic reactionz It sucks and once your body gets over that hump, it's easy going from there on out. I won't switch brands ever. I've tried making my own, but keep coming back to PPP

reviews.t: Good, but not as good as the original.
reviews.x: I think the original strength works better. To be expected, I guess. I bought the light version because I was experiencing some skin irritation once in a while with the original. This one does not irritate, but does not kill the smell as well, either. Will probably work well during the colder months, though.

reviews.t: Rubs in perfectly! Disappears into skin and works well.
reviews.x: This pit paste is great. It works well, rubs in nicely, and smells nice. I had been using other "natural" deodorants in a tube but I ended up having to rub them in with my fingers anyway (and even then they did not rub in well). When those other brands ran out, I decided to just go ahead and purchase this pit paste which is intended to be applied with fingers. It rubs in well and disappears into skin.

I smell bad. I've used tons of different products and went for the light first. Some say they have gotten rashes from this which is why I tried the light (less baking soda) but I didn't, I'll try regular next. I find applying with my fingers isn't hard at all and it is so soft on them. I still sweat but I feel I don't stink (or at least much) to the end of the day This is not an anti perspirant

reviews.t: PRIMAL PIT PASTE LIGHT NATURAL DEODORANT
reviews.x: This is an excellent product. It will provide you with protection without giving you the terrible rash. I am very happy with this deodorant and would highly recommend it.
Less irritation for sure, but will require a second application mid day. Not crazy about the scent, I was hoping for more vanilla but the lavender overpowered it.
Got this recently as I was looking for a nontoxic deodorant. This is EWG recommended and I can thankfully say it works great and smells great.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the light version effective at controlling odor, with several calling it the best natural deodorant they've tried.
Reviewers with sensitive skin report the light version does not cause the irritation or rash they experienced with the regular strength formula.
Some reviewers find the light version does not control odor as well as the original or for a full day, especially in hot conditions or with heavy sweating.
A few reviewers report skin problems such as irritation, itching, or discoloration despite using the light version.
Reviewers describe the lavender scent as light and pleasant, though some find it not strong enough to mask odor.
